title: Settings
presentationHint: Larger text, hidden person codes, arrow key navigation ← → (university projector).

modes.practiceText: Real work – encrypted records of the people you work with.
modes.demoText: Fictional case studies. Changes in DEMO mode do not affect practice data.

resetDemoText: Training cases will return to their initial state (in the current language).
autoLockHint: The app also always locks when it goes to the background.

password.note: Remember the new password – it cannot be recovered. Older backups still open with the password valid when they were made.
password.tooShort: The password must have at least 6 characters.

backup.title: Backup
backup.text: Data exists on this device only. Losing the phone, uninstalling the app or clearing browser data = losing the data. Back up regularly and keep the file somewhere safe. The file is encrypted with your password.
backup.importText: Enter the password that was valid when the backup was made.
backup.replaceWarning: Restoring replaces all current data with the backup. The backup's password becomes the app password.

errors.invalid-file: This is not a valid Harbor backup file.
errors.unsupported-version: The backup comes from a newer version of the app – please update.
errors.corrupted: The backup file is damaged. Your current data is unchanged.

wipeText: Permanently deletes all data and the password from this device.
wipeConfirm: This cannot be undone. Make sure you have a backup.
countryHint: Help system, “Where to refer?”, legal basis, crisis numbers and DEMO cases.

bio.labelPasskey: Unlock with Face ID / Touch ID (passkey)
bio.hint: Optional. The password is still required every 7 days, after 5 failed attempts and after the biometrics on the device change.
bio.enableText: Enter your password – a copy of the data key will be protected by this device’s biometrics. Turning it off deletes this copy.
bio.unsupported: This device or browser does not support secure biometric unlock (the PRF extension is required).
bio.error: Could not enable biometrics. Please try again.
bio.stepPrompt: Password accepted. Tap the button below and confirm with your fingerprint, face or Face ID.
bio.stepConfirm: The passkey was created. Confirm once more to finish.
